prompt: In the lesson's connection diagram (Digitakt, DIY synth, USB audio interface, computer running Ableton), which device is the USB host?

options.explanation: The Digitakt's USB-B port is for connecting to a computer host; it acts as a USB device.
A USB audio interface is a device that the computer hosts.
Unless you build it with a USB host port and host firmware, a dev board's USB is a device port.
Correct. The computer hosts the interface (and the Digitakt if its USB is connected). The Digitakt-to-synth link uses DIN MIDI, which needs no host.

workedExample:
List each USB connection and its roles:

```
interface USB  -> computer (host)
Digitakt USB   -> computer (host)
Digitakt->synth: DIN MIDI, no USB
```

Every USB link has exactly one host, and in this design it's always the computer. That is why the Digitakt can drive the synth even with the computer switched off.

prompt: Which statements about Digitakt MIDI tracks match Elektron's manuals? Select all that apply.

options.text: On the original Digitakt, tracks 9–16 are dedicated MIDI tracks
options.explanation: Correct. The original has eight dedicated MIDI tracks (TRK 9–16).

options.text: On the Digitakt II, any of the 16 tracks can be a MIDI track once the MIDI machine is assigned to it
options.explanation: Correct, per the Digitakt II manual.

options.text: On both, a MIDI track's channel is set with CHAN on its SRC page
options.explanation: Correct. CHAN ranges over OFF and 1–16 and can't be parameter-locked.

options.text: MIDI tracks on both models send audio as well as MIDI
options.explanation: MIDI tracks generate no sound; their data goes out of MIDI OUT or USB.

options.text: The Digitakt II offers only 8 assignable CCs per MIDI track
options.explanation: The Digitakt II has 16 assignable CCs per MIDI track; the original has 8.

workedExample:
From the manuals checked on 16 October 2026:

```
          Digitakt     Digitakt II
MIDI trks 9-16 fixed   any of 16
CCs/track 8            16
channel   SRC > CHAN   SRC > CHAN
```

Confirm against your own model's current manual: menus and limits can change between OS versions.
